Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, r As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 60, 30).Name = "A"
    ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 100, 40, 80, 20).Name = "B"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A")): s = s & "|" & r.Left & "," & r.Top & "," & r.Width & "," & r.Height & "," & r.Name & "," & r.Visible
    Case 1
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): s = s & "|" & r.Left & "," & r.Top & "," & r.Width & "," & r.Height
    Case 2
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): s = s & "|" & r.Name
    Case 3
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): s = s & "|" & r.Visible & "," & r.Rotation & "," & r.LockAspectRatio & "," & r.HorizontalFlip
    Case 4
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): s = s & "|" & r.AlternativeText & "," & r.Title
    Case 5
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A")): r.Left = 50: r.Top = 60
    Case 6
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): r.Left = 50
    Case 7
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): r.Top = 70
    Case 8
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): r.Width = 200
    Case 9
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): r.Height = 100
    Case 10
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): r.Rotation = 30
    Case 11
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A")): r.Name = "Z"
    Case 12
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): r.Name = "Z"
    Case 13
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): r.AlternativeText = "both": s = s & "|" & ws.Shapes(1).AlternativeText & "," & ws.Shapes(2).AlternativeText & "," & r.AlternativeText
    Case 14
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): ws.Shapes("A").Rotation = 10: s = s & "|" & r.Rotation
    Case 15
        Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")): r.LockAspectRatio = msoTrue: s = s & "|" & r.LockAspectRatio & "," & ws.Shapes(2).LockAspectRatio
    End Select
    Tried = "ok" & s & "|" & ws.Shapes("A").Left & "," & ws.Shapes("A").Top & "," & ws.Shapes("A").Width & "," & ws.Shapes("A").Height & "," & ws.Shapes("A").Rotation & "," & ws.Shapes("A").Visible & ";" & ws.Shapes(2).Name & "," & ws.Shapes(2).Left & "," & ws.Shapes(2).Top & "," & ws.Shapes(2).Width & "," & ws.Shapes(2).Height & "," & ws.Shapes(2).Rotation & "," & ws.Shapes(2).Visible
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 15
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
